title: Thick Açaí Bowl with Banana, Berries and Granola
summary: Frozen unsweetened açaí is blended with frozen banana and berries into a thick, spoonable base, then topped with banana, strawberries, blueberries and granola.

ingredients.item: frozen unsweetened açaí pulp (2 packs), broken into pieces

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Pour the milk into the blender first so the blades catch, then add the açaí, frozen banana, berries and honey. Blend on low, pressing down with the tamper and stopping to scrape down as needed, until thick and smooth like soft-serve. Add more milk only a spoonful at a time, or the bowl will turn runny.

steps.title: Top and serve
steps.text: Spoon the mixture into the chilled bowls and arrange the banana, strawberries, blueberries and granola in rows on top. Eat straight away, before it melts.

tips: Too much liquid is the commonest mistake; it should hold a spoon upright.
Freeze the banana in slices for at least 4 hours so it blends smoothly.
Chill the bowls in the freezer for 10 minutes to keep the base thick longer.
Add the granola just before eating so it stays crunchy.
storage: Best eaten straight away. The blended base can be frozen in a lidded tub for up to 1 month; soften for 10 minutes before serving. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
